surfaceTexture.promptSummary: Six distinct photoreal orthographic top-down prehistoric subtropical island cutouts arranged in a 3 by 2 transparent atlas, with irregular coastlines, coves, rocky shelves, dense primitive vegetation, exposed rock, diffuse lighting, and no people, animals, buildings, text or water background.

landscapeHeadedBrowserReview.result: All six softened islands stayed visible without browser warnings, and their wide-screen composition occupied staggered upper, middle and lower depth bands instead of a single upper row.

portraitFrustumContractReview.result: All six portrait island centres project inside the phone overview frustum, remain distributed across upper, middle and lower background bands, and the runtime switches layouts at the same 1.2 aspect breakpoint as the stacked subject camera.

prototypeSources: A remains the explicit review fallback

rendering.background: analytic seam-free atmospheric gradient with restrained procedural high-cloud structure
rendering.sea: opaque 520 metre world-space procedural surface with distance haze, long swell and sky reflection
rendering.coast: no foreground or enclosing coast; one active set of six reduced low-relief terrain landforms remains roughly 65 metres below the subjects and more than 65 metres away by slant distance, using a staggered landscape arrangement above the side-by-side camera footprint and a separate smaller portrait arrangement inside the rotated stacked-subject sea footprint; both layouts retain 64-segment coastlines, the same six photoreal top-down transparent island cutouts, five-tap mip-softened sampling, restrained distance haze, narrow submerged shore slopes and stable raised cores
